headline: Timekeeper — vow ceremony timer
intro: Record the exact wall-clock moment of each vow or ceremony step — refuge, Bodhisattva vows, and any rite you define — to the millisecond. Built for retreat timekeepers.

about.title: A record, not a stopwatch
about.body: Timekeeper captures the exact wall-clock moment a person completes each step of a vow ceremony. Nothing counts up or down. Each tap stores a timestamp to the millisecond and never recomputes it afterward — so the record stays faithful to when the timekeeper tapped, as close as possible to the preceptor's snap.

audience.title: Who it is for
audience.body: The app is built for retreat timekeepers running refuge ceremonies, Bodhisattva vow rites, Worlds of Wisdom-style ceremonies, and other timed vows. The preceptor and participants never touch the app — only the timekeeper does, one aspirant at a time, moving through each defined step before the next person begins.

features.title: What you get
items: Millisecond timestamps for each ceremony step — one tap per vow or phase.
Custom fields: set up refuge (Buddha, Dharma, Sangha), Bodhisattva vows, or any steps your rite needs.
Offline-ready PWA: works on retreat wifi after a single online visit.
CSV export per person or for the whole retreat, plus shareable record cards.
Undo and redo when you need to correct a moment without losing the session.

steps.title: Add people
steps.body: Name each aspirant and set the retreat.

steps.title: Check the clock
steps.body: Verify time zone and network time before you begin.

steps.title: Record each snap
steps.body: One tap per vow or step — export CSV or share cards after.

footnote: Offline-ready after one visit. No account needed.

install.title: Install for offline use
install.intro: Open Timekeeper once on retreat wifi, then install it so the timer still works when the network drops.
install.installed: Timekeeper is installed on this device.
install.ios: Tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".
install.android: Open the browser menu, then tap "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
install.desktop: Use the install icon in the address bar, or tap Install app when it appears here.
